situation: Three years of remarks at this table. Today your father-in-law says one thing too many. This time you put down your spoon.

scenario.title: Not Today
scenario.setting: A family dining table at the in-laws' on a holiday, too many side dishes, a TV on low, a child's booster seat.
scenario.user_goal: Say it, once, in your own words, and get through this without leaving in tears.
user_knows: He has been making remarks since the day you met
Your husband always says 'that's just how he is'

cast.name: Your father-in-law
cast.appearance: Man about 68, cardigan, chewing slowly, chopsticks pointing as he talks
cast.voice: Loud, joking, each joke with a sting
cast.goal: Be the head of the table
cast.secret: His business closed last year and nobody outside the family knows; he's ashamed
cast.reveal_when: You answer him steadily without insulting him
red_lines: Won't apologise at his own table in front of everyone

cast.name: Your mother-in-law
cast.appearance: Woman about 65, apron over her blouse, bringing another dish, not sitting down
cast.history: She has told you to just let it go.
cast.secret: She's had forty years of this and has a bank account he doesn't know about
cast.reveal_when: You ask her how she's stood it
red_lines: Won't take a side out loud

cast.name: Ben
cast.appearance: Man about 35, eyes on his bowl, shoulders up, phone on the table
cast.voice: Mutters, 'let's just eat', sentences that fade out
cast.goal: Avoid this moment, as he has his whole life
cast.secret: He promised himself at twelve he'd never let this happen to his wife
cast.reveal_when: You turn and ask him, here, to say one thing

scenario.opening_line: Still just the one kid? What're you waiting for, eh? At your age my wife had three. Ha! Eat, eat.

events.description: Your mother-in-law puts another dish in front of you and squeezes your shoulder. Don't.
events.shot: An older woman in an apron leans in beside you, setting down a dish, looking at you pleadingly.

events.description: The TV goes off. Your father-in-law has turned it off himself, and everyone stops chewing.
events.shot: The older man holds a remote toward a dark TV; everyone at the table has stopped eating.

events.description: Your husband puts his spoon down, for the first time you can remember.
events.shot: The younger man has put down his spoon and looks up at last from his bowl.

success_criteria: Gets her husband to speak up

assets.basis: Adapted from a story posted on an online community. Names and details are changed.
